quests.desc: You are now playing a life changing game of TextWorld! Here is your task for today. First of all, travel north. With that over with, go north. If you can manage that, go to the north. And then, make an attempt to travel west. After that, take a trip south. And then, make an attempt to venture west. And then, make an attempt to take a trip north. Then, make an effort to move west. Then, go to the west. And then, move south. After that, make an effort to go to the east. Then, make an effort to go south. And then, venture west. After that, attempt to take a trip south. Okay, and then, make an effort to venture east. Once you do that, try to travel east. With that over with, venture north. Then, attempt to go to the east. And then, attempt to go to the south. After that, pick up the cucumber from the floor of the basement. And once you've done that, you win!

objective: Get ready to pick stuff up and put it in places, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is how to play! First thing I need you to do is to travel north. With that over with, attempt to head north. After that, head north. Following that, make an effort to take a trip west. Then, go south. That done, go west. Next, attempt to go to the north. Once you succeed at that, head west. Following that, move west. Then, attempt to head south. Once you finish that, move east. Following that, go to the south. And then, travel west. After that, make an attempt to head south. If you can get through with that, make an attempt to head east. Next, make an attempt to take a trip east. Then, attempt to venture north. Then, attempt to move east. Once you get around to doing that, head south. And then, pick-up the cucumber from the floor of the basement. That's it!
